name: workflow
description: A small engineering workflow for planning, implementation, review, test audits, and technical writing.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, and review engineering work.
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills cover planning, authorized engineering changes, read-only review, test quality audits, and concise technical writing. Guidance is loaded progressively and keeps changes bounded, simple, reusable, and independently verifiable.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:engineering for authorized code changes, debugging, refactoring, and review corrections.
Use $workflow:review for read-only review or final verification of an exact range or artifact.
Use $workflow:planning for specs, plans, tickets, or exploration; use $workflow:technical-writing for prose.
